$description: Client-side state and HTTP caching policy for shared office desktops (finding F07). Normative for B1. Tested by tests/test_client_policy.py; the B1 implementation must add an HTTP-level test that asserts these headers on every route class.

original_pdf.notes: originals stream after hash check; never cached by the browser

working_document.notes: Document Studio files, page images and OCR output; owner-checked; never cached

static_assets_hashed.notes: content-hashed JS/CSS/fonts/icons only; contain no corpus or user data

offline_behaviour: When the server is unreachable the client shows a reconnecting notice and no cached content; there is no offline cached view.

pdfjs.transport: authenticated custom range transport (PDF.js PDFDataRangeTransport); first byte fetch is a bounded single range; no stock URL open
pdfjs.metadata_request: bounded authorized metadata call (copy identity, length, range capability) before first range
pdfjs.proof: R2-N01 (PR #53 Serving §10): large-PDF bootstrap, near-end jump and mid-range withdrawal must be proven in P4 before the route is enabled

protected_responses.conditional_requests: no ETag, Last-Modified or 304 on protected responses; policy validated before any 200/206
protected_responses.compression: disabled on protected routes until exact slice accounting is proven
protected_responses.static_or_sendfile: forbidden for vault originals and derived content; all protected bytes go through the single delivery gateway
protected_responses.progress_events: bounded authenticated polling; SignalR/SSE only for content-free status until the delivery adapter is proven
